views.label: Palm
views.title: Your palm
views.instruction: Open your palm to the camera with the coin flat in the middle of your palm.

views.label: Back of hand
views.title: The back of your hand
views.instruction: Turn your hand over. Rest the coin flat in the middle of the back of your hand, spread your fingers and hold still.
views.note: A second angle lets us check the first one.

messages.no_hand: Show the back of your hand to the camera
messages.palm_not_flat: Keep the back of your hand flat, facing the camera
messages.coin_not_on_palm: Place the coin flat in the middle of the back of your hand
messages.coin_tilted: Hold your phone level, parallel to the back of your hand

views.label: Side view
views.title: The side of your hand
views.instruction: Turn your hand on its edge, thumb side up, with the coin resting flat on the side of your hand facing the camera. Hold still.
views.note: Not used for your size yet; we are testing how to use this angle.

messages.no_hand: Show the side of your hand to the camera
messages.coin_missing: Rest the coin flat on the side of your hand
messages.coin_not_found: Rest the coin flat on the side of your hand, facing the camera

hand_length_mm.label: Hand length
hand_length_mm.definition: Straight-line distance from the MediaPipe wrist landmark (0) to the middle-fingertip landmark (12), in the palm plane, with the hand flat and fingers extended. Approximates the glove-industry definition 'distal wrist crease to tip of middle finger'; the offset between landmark 0 and the wrist crease must be calibrated from reference measurements.

palm_length_mm.label: Palm length
palm_length_mm.definition: Straight-line distance from the wrist landmark (0) to the middle-finger MCP joint-centre landmark (9).

mcp_span_mm.label: Palm width (knuckle joint centres)
mcp_span_mm.definition: Distance between the index-finger MCP (5) and little-finger MCP (17) joint-centre landmarks. This is narrower than the anthropometric palm breadth measured skin-edge to skin-edge; converting it to breadth requires a fitted model (see measurement_calibration.json).

thumb_length_mm.label: Thumb length
thumb_length_mm.definition: Polyline length thumb MCP (2) -> IP (3) -> tip (4). The thumb usually rotates out of the palm plane, so this is reported as low confidence.

index_length_mm.label: Index finger length
index_length_mm.definition: Polyline length MCP (5) -> PIP (6) -> DIP (7) -> tip (8), measured from the joint centre, which is proximal to the palmar finger crease used in anthropometry.

middle_length_mm.label: Middle finger length
middle_length_mm.definition: Polyline length MCP (9) -> PIP (10) -> DIP (11) -> tip (12), joint-centre based.

ring_length_mm.label: Ring finger length
ring_length_mm.definition: Polyline length MCP (13) -> PIP (14) -> DIP (15) -> tip (16), joint-centre based.

little_length_mm.label: Little finger length
little_length_mm.definition: Polyline length MCP (17) -> PIP (18) -> DIP (19) -> tip (20), joint-centre based.
